en.TD_MENU_APPEAR: Large brown doors open to reveal a large Rococo-era throne room. In the middle of the room a blue, bean-shaped humanoid figure is asleep on a large throne. He has a white mustache and a golden crown. He has no arms, and two stubby cartoonish legs. Behind the throne are four long red banners.
en.TD_LOBBY_APPEAR: The king, with his back to the players, looks up at a wall of empty frames labeled “Wall of Friends”. As players join, their avatars occupy one of eight gold frames. His back is in shadow, but the top of his buttcrack is visible.
en.TD_LOBBY_DISAPPEAR: The king walks off screen to the right.
en.TD_LOBBY_AVATAR_DESCRIPTIONS_1: A small red cartoon-styled humanoid figure, with a square-shaped body, a big round nose, small jowls, and droopy tired eyes.
en.TD_LOBBY_AVATAR_DESCRIPTIONS_2: A small yellow cartoon-styled humanoid figure, with a square shaped body, no nose, an open smiling mouth, and oval eyes with large black pupils.
en.TD_LOBBY_AVATAR_DESCRIPTIONS_3: A small orange cartoon-styled humanoid figure, with a square-shaped body, small black dots for eyes, and a wide toothy grin.
en.TD_LOBBY_AVATAR_DESCRIPTIONS_4: A small green cartoon-styled humanoid figure, with a square shaped body, a pointy angular noise, a mouth that looks like a check mark under the nose, and two almond-shaped eyes with big black pupils.
en.TD_LOBBY_AVATAR_DESCRIPTIONS_5: A small teal cartoon styled humanoid figure, with a square-shaped body, a long oval nose, and two small eyes with two eyelashes on each eye.
en.TD_LOBBY_AVATAR_DESCRIPTIONS_6: A small purple cartoon-styled humanoid figure, with a square-shaped body, a closed-mouth smile, and a single large cyclops-style eye with a long oval pupil.
en.TD_LOBBY_AVATAR_DESCRIPTIONS_7: A small gray cartoon-styled humanoid figure with a robotic face: two eyes that are separate yellow squares, a row of yellow squares to symbolize a mouth, and two dots below that imply bolts on its body.
en.TD_LOBBY_AVATAR_DESCRIPTIONS_8: A small pink cartoon-styled humanoid figure, with a square-shaped body, a crossed line on the top of the head implying a scar, two black dots for eyes that are set wide apart, and a closed mouth smile in the loose shape of a sideways bracket.
en.TD_TITLE_SCREEN_APPEAR: The king, still facing away from the audience, walks in to a new room from the left and stops in front of a picture frame that says “MEGAPALS.” Next to the frame is a white marble bust of himself.
en.TD_TITLE_SCREEN_DISAPPEAR: The king walks out of the room to the right.
en.TD_TUTORIAL_APPEAR: The king walks in from the left. He leads players through the tutorial, and illustrates verbal points with oil painting illustrations of what he is saying.
en.TD_TUTORIAL_DISAPPEAR: The king walks over to a fireman’s pole to the right, leading into a hole in the floor. By the hole there is a fold-up caution sign. He jumps on the pole, and slowly/painfully slides down it into the hole.
en.TD_BUMPER_1_APPEAR: A blue-gray star-filled background with a title that says: ROUND ONE - WARM UP
en.TD_BUMPER_1_DISAPPEAR: The king falls on the ground and splats into a puddle. He reforms and jumps towards the players, growing so large that his body now occupies the full game screen.
en.TD_TUTORIAL_2_APPEAR: A forest-green star-filled background with a title that says: ROUND TWO - CHAIN. The king drops into frame suspended from the ceiling by a chain. He is the same shape, but now has green skin. He is holding a large orange phone-type device.
en.TD_TUTORIAL_2_DISAPPEAR: The king jumps off the chain towards the players, growing so large that his green body now occupies the full game screen.
en.TD_TUTORIAL_3_APPEAR: A magenta star-filled background with a title that says: ROUND THREE - PANDER. The king pops up from the bottom of the screen. He now has magenta skin. In the instructions, he faces away from the players, looking closely at his orange phone-like device as his points are illustrated by famed pictures of gameplay.
en.TD_TUTORIAL_3_DISAPPEAR: The king’s wrinkly body, twisted around, explodes. The parts splatter, now occupying the whole game screen.
en.TD_WRITING_SCREEN_PROMPT_APPEAR: The king’s face occupies the center of the screen. He makes a face like he’s pushing something, and then after a satisfied face, the prompt pops out of his body in the center of the screen.
en.TD_WRITING_SCREEN_PLAYERS_APPEAR: Player avatars stand in a line at the bottom of the screen.
en.TD_WRITING_SCREEN_DISAPPEAR: The king’s face melts off the screen, transitioning to a soft background with blurry colorful bubbles.
en.TD_WRITING_SCREEN_CHAIN_ROUND_APPEAR: Player avatars stand in a line at the bottom of the screen. {{PLAYER}} and {{PLAYER}} have crowns above their heads, indicating they are the pair in the lead.
en.TD_WRITING_SCREEN_CHAIN_ROUND_SECOND_LOO: The user-generated prompts are connected in order of appearance by a cartoon-style silver chain. A small black bubble in the top right indicates that this is prompt {{LOOP_NUMBER}} of four.
en.TD_WRITING_SCREEN_PANDER_ROUND_APPEAR: The prompt once again pops out of the full-screen king’s body. Where the king’s face used to be, certain player avatars pop out, as if they are nestled in the king’s body.
en.TD_WRITING_SCREEN_PANDER_ROUND_MEGAPALS_: This prompt is about Megapals {{PLAYER}} and {{PLAYER}}.
en.TD_WRITING_SCREEN_PANDER_ROUND_SOLO_MEGA: This prompt is about one of the Megapals, {{PLAYER}}.
en.TD_ WRITING_SCREEN_PANDER_ROUND_PROGRESS: Player avatars stand in a line at the bottom of the screen. A small black bubble in the top right indicates that this is prompt {{LOOP_NUMBER}} of three.
en.TD_MATCH_SCREEN_APPEAR: All player avatars float in a circle in the center of the screen. They each have black speech bubbles that say how many points they have.
en.TD_MATCH_SCREEN_WORD_BUBBLE_APPEAR: Word bubbles showing matches appear in the middle of the circle, with lines pointing out indicating who matched on that word.
en.TD_MATCH_SCREEN_MEGAMATCH_APPEAR: The main game screen is overlaid with a colorful title that says MEGAMATCH with a celebratory star visual.
en.TD_MATCH_SCREEN_MEGAMATCH_AWARD: All players are awarded one point.
en.TD_OUTLIERS_SCREEN_APPEAR: The title UNUSED WORDS: VOTE FOR YOUR NEXT STARTER appears at the top of the screen. Player names are listed on the bottom. Colorful bubbles with words players wrote inside appear on screen. The bubbles get bigger the more players vote for them.
en.TD_OUTLIERS_SCREEN_WINNER: The most popular word is {{WORD}} written by {{PLAYER}}, giving them +{{POINTS}} points.
en.TD_MINIMAP_APPEAR: Smaller versions of the avatars form another circle on the soft bubbly screen. In the recap, the avatars indicate strong match connections by stretching out long cartoonish arms and grabbing hands with the other player. The avatars also change orientation on the screen to indicate relative closeness.
en.TD_MINIMAP_WINNER: {{PLAYER}} and {{PLAYER}} connected, Friend Score of {{SCORE}}. Their avatars flash, indicating that they are now the pair in the lead.
en.TD_CHAIN_RECAP_APPEAR: On a background of soft colorful bubbles, the title CHAIN RECAP appears at the top of the screen. Four small frames appear, each connecting the selected words, attached to the avatar of the player who wrote them.
en.TD_CHAIN_RECAP_READ: The chain was: {{GAME PROMPT}}, {{WORD}} by {{PLAYER}}, {{WORD}} by {{PLAYER}}, {{WORD}} by {{PLAYER}}, and {{WORD}} by {{PLAYER}}.
en.TD_HIGHLIGHTED_MATCH_LIKE_REVEAL_APPEAR: The avatars of the writing players appear in a circle shape on the left of the screen. The targeted players appear on the right of the screen. Words the targeted players liked appear in a black thought bubble above their avatars.
en.TD_HIGHLIGHTED_MATCH_LIKE_REVEAL_DOUBLE_: Both players liked {{WORD}}, {{WORD}}, {{WORD}}. They got {{POINTS}} points.
en.TD_WINNER_SCREEN_APPEAR: The avatars of the two Megapals {{PLAYER}} and {{PLAYER}} stand up and smash their avatars together into one big square avatar - the avatar is a single large grinning face with two arms, four legs, and the two player colors split down the middle. Behind them, a looming, huge version of the blue-skinned king rises behind them. A large blue cartoon hand reaches in from the right and places a crown on the winners’ heads.
en.TD_POSTGAME_APPEAR: In the upper left corner, golden frames showing additional player awards drop in and out of sight in a rotation.
en.TD_POSTGAME_SUPERLATIVE_AWARD: The superlative {{SUPERLATIVE}} was won by {{PLAYER}} for {{DESCRIPTION}}
en.NEW_FRIENDS_CLOSE_FRIENDS_DESCRIPTION: Si ce paramètre est activé, les entrées qui se reposent sur une forte connaissance personnelle des autres joueurs seront moins susceptibles d'apparaître.
